shortDescription: Shared ability AI for NPC pawns plus player autocast, split out of Entad Framework. Entad and Bastle Framework use it as a soft dependency through gated compat assemblies; without it they fall back to vanilla's simple casting.
body:
## What it is
The ability AI that used to live in Entad Framework (`Source/AbilityAI/`), now its own mod so Entad Framework and Bastle Framework share one copy. Namespace `AbilityAI`, keyed prefix `AAI_`, Harmony id `saintwacko.abilityai`. Builds 1.6 and 1.7 (LoadFolders, shared `Source/`, per-version csproj under `1.6/Source` and `1.7/Source`, `Source/AbilityAI.Build.csproj` builds both). Krafs refs; Harmony is the only hard dependency.

## How abilities opt in
An `AbilityAIExtension` on the AbilityDef naming a worker class (AoEHostile, AoEFriendly, SelfBuff, Movement, Cover, Recovery, TargetHostile, TargetFriendly, Defensive, Rescue, Calm, Interrupt, Firefighting). Several extensions per ability are allowed and are tried by priority. Royalty's combat psycasts get extensions from `Patches/AbilityAI_Royalty.xml` (FindMod Royalty).

## Who casts
- Driver: a postfix on `Pawn_JobTracker.DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob`, at most once per 30 ticks per pawn, plus a global minimum gap between casts.
- NPCs (hostile, non-hostile, animals, mechs; each toggleable): cast abilities a host hook claims, or any ability with an extension when "Also use abilities no mod claims" is on.
- Player pawns: only abilities set to autocast from a right-click on the gizmo (saved in a WorldComponent), drafted only, never mid-move. Player pawns in a mental break act as NPCs only with BreakCasting on.
- Approach: ranged NPCs walk into range for abilities with `approachDistance`.

## Host API (soft-dependency contract)
Hosts must keep all references to this assembly in a compat DLL loaded via `IfModActive="saintwacko.AbilityAI"`. A type in the host's main DLL that implements our interface would make RimWorld drop the whole host DLL when this mod is missing.
- `AbilityAIHooks.Register(IAbilityAIHook)`: Vote Claim/Veto/NoOpinion per pawn+ability, and Notify_AICast.
- `AbilityAIInfo.Register<T>(radius, hediff, stuns)`: describes a host's own effect comp to the workers (replaces implementing `IAbilityAIInfo`, which still works for hard dependents). Cached per comp-properties object.
- `AbilityAIDriver.Handles(pawn, ability)`: whether this mod is deciding for that pair.

## Vanilla stand-down
Hosts keep `aiCanUse` on so their abilities still get vanilla's simple casting without this mod. A postfix on `Ability.AICanTargetNow` returns false whenever `Handles` is true (setting "Replace vanilla's casting", default on), so vanilla's fight AI and Bastle's own JobGiver skip abilities this mod is handling. It only does work when vanilla already answered true.

## Settings
Own settings page (`AbilityAIMod`): enabled, per pawn kind, unclaimed, vanilla stand-down, approach, player autocast, break casting, min gap slider, dev debug log, reset.

## Handoffs
`.circinus/handoff/entad-framework.md` and `.circinus/handoff/bastle-framework.md`: step lists for each host's agent (remove moved code, gated compat assembly, extensions moved into gated patches, loadAfter only).
